name: Aceternity UI
summary: Library of 112+ animated React components, 170 landing page blocks and 17 Next.js templates built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.

Free components install from the shadcn registry or by copy-paste; the paid All-Access plan adds 200+ premium blocks and the full template set. Ships JSON API, llms-full.txt and AI-ready prompts for coding agents.
